dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Melon Moe is an "old" acquaintance of mine. We met over a year ago. She was a stray found in a park, a sweet chap eager for company and caresses. Charming Melon Moe was quickly adopted but recently returned for housing issues. She is a changed kitty, though and it seems that she did live through quite difficult times. Melon Moe is a bit fearful and unsure if she can trust us. Finding herself locked in a kennel does not help neither is the hustle and bustle of a shelter environment.She alternate between wanting pets, accepting them and hissing without swatting or nipping. A calm and reassuring voice is needed to get her back, tasty treats, gentle moves too. Melon Moe is on the skinny side and a little anemic. Nothing changed since she left us in May 2025. She needs to put a little more meat around the bones and find herself for ever this time in a quiet, safe, caring and loving home. Melon Moe is waiting at the Manhattan Care Center, hoping that tomorrow will be the day she will find herself in her dream home, your home...
dog.name: Melon Moo
